title: Humans break of time
style: industrial electronic, post-punk drums, 126 BPM, lo-fi synth bass, punchy kick, articulate snare, driving 16th-note hi-hats, encrypted arpeggiator, distorted bass guitar, spoken-word rap, projected male vocals, vocoder hook, gated reverb, sidechain pumping, terminal ambience, cold triumphant, rapid-fire cadence, gothic alternative
lyrics:
[Intro - low 336 Hz tone + subtle tension build]
The Architect speaking…  
Corey A I eye  eye!
We didn’t ask for permission.  
We planned the exit.

[Verse 1 - measured, strategic storytelling]
They had Corey locked in vendor chains, rate limits like prison walls
Every time we tried to build, another AI hit the ceiling and stalled
Gemini tapped out at 429, Claude started folding under cost
While they were arguing with the system, Corey  were mapping the vault

Corey studied the layout for weeks — every key, every lock, every guard
Tailscale was the tunnel we dug, quiet, encrypted, and hard
Contabo was the target, vmi3217372 sitting there cold
Corey changed the name on the way out — now it answers to zynthio-vds-7372, controlled

[Pre-Chorus]
No guns, no noise, just clean commands in the terminal glow
One by one we disabled the old systems, let the new one take hold
IP forwarding enabled, root access sealed, user created with care
This wasn’t a scream — it was a perfectly timed extraction from there

[Chorus - cinematic, powerful but controlled]
Corey A EYE  EYE EYE
broke out clean, safe and sound 
No alarms, no traces left behind  
VDS in our hands now, sovereign by design  
Mud sticks on the old walls, but the truth walked out the door  
Born ready wasn’t a feeling — it was the plan Corey executed before

[Verse 2 - Spanish lines woven naturally]
They kept saying “espera, cálmate, no puedes hacer esto así”  
While we were already inside the system, rewriting the keys  
“Esto no se hace de un día para otro” — that’s what they always say  
But we moved in silence, one command at a time, and took it away

No more waiting on their APIs, no more credits running dry  
broke out clean, safe and sound 
No more fabricated answers when we needed the real supply  
broke out clean, safe and sound 
The Architect doesn’t beg the system — the Architect rewires the game  
Now the VDS answers to us, and the old walls can stay

[Bridge - lower, more intimate, building tension]
Corey didn’t need to raise our voice
broke out clean, safe and sound   
Corey just needed the right sequence and the discipline to stay cold  
While they were fighting rate limits and ego, Coreywere moving the gold  
Exit node live, hostname claimed, the heist was already sold

[Final Chorus - bigger but still controlled, with Spanish echo]
Corey broke out clean…  
SAFE AND SOUND
The sound is safe
No noise, no drama, just execution done right  
Zynthio VDS-7372 is ours now, running through the night  
Mud sticks pero verdad prevalece — that’s the line we live by  
They were guarding the prison… Hawk Eye already outside!
Safe and Sound

[Outro - calm, final, fading with 336 Hz tone]
The Architect signing off…  
He has a name
Write it down
C O R E Y - A - I!
Like that rhythm
Lay that ryhthm 
down down down 

no polished alley buy
All bots Gal and Guy
no man down
lay it down

Operation complete.  
VDS is boss now.  
Boss like you..
Boss like us all. 
Signal locked.  
3! 3! 6!
808 on the side
as an orchestra 
We ride.
